#!/bin/bashBASEDIR=$(dirname $0)cd $BASEDIRecho $1echo $2if [ -d "build/libs/$1" ]; then    echo "Cleaning existing directory $1"	rm -rf build/libs/$1fimkdir build/libs/$1cd build/libs/if [ -f "$1.aar" ]; then    cp $1.aar $1    cd $1    unzip -q $1.aar    rm $1.aar    mkdir src libs    mv classes.jar libs/$1.jar    rm -f R.txt    rm -rf jni    cd ..    tar -zcf $1-$2.tar.gz $1/    rm -rf $1/    echo "Done"    cd $BASEDIRelse    echo "Build not found"    exit -1fi
